title: AudioManifestItem
description: One prerecorded radio audio message of the demo scenario, with its reference transcript and expected outputs.

audio_id.description: Stable identifier of the audio message (e.g. audio_01).

scenario_timestamp.description: Offset in seconds from incident start at which this message is released in the scenario.

clean_path.description: Relative path to the clean WAV version.

radio_path.description: Relative path to the radio-degraded WAV version.

reference_transcript.description: Exact French reference transcript of the message.

expected_event_types.description: RadioEvent event_type values expected to be extracted from this message.
